scripts.check: node scripts/check-node.mjs && turbo run lint typecheck && pnpm gen --check && vitest run --project unit --project integration --project web --project types
scripts.check:full: pnpm check && pnpm test:tz && pnpm e2e
scripts.test: vitest run --project unit --project integration --project web --project types
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --coverage --project unit --project integration --project web --project types
scripts.test:tz: TZ=Europe/Stockholm NM_TEST_PG_TZ=Europe/Stockholm vitest run --project unit --project integration
scripts.license:gate: pnpm sbom --sbom-format cyclonedx --sbom-type application --prod --split --out sbom/prod/%s.cdx.json && pnpm sbom --sbom-format cyclonedx --sbom-type application --split --out sbom/all/%s.cdx.json && node scripts/license-gate.mjs --prod sbom/prod --all sbom/all
scripts.e2e: pnpm build && playwright install chromium && playwright test
scripts.docs:screenshots: pnpm build && playwright install chromium && NORTHMES_DOCS_SCREENSHOTS=1 playwright test e2e/docs-screenshots.spec.ts
